extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors who want to create a new Wikipedia page (here: 'Comedy Africa'), including procedural requirements, checks to perform before creating, and next steps if a page is missing or deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed status required
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is presented as a prerequisite for creating articles on Wikipedia; if you are not autoconfirmed you cannot create the page directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the article directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed), submit a draft via the article wizard or file a request for a new article so others can review and publish it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles and alternative titles/spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Comedy Africa" in existing articles. Please search for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check whether the topic already exists under a different name or spelling to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect inbound links to see whether coverage of the topic already exists within other articles, which may indicate a redirect or different article title is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check sister projects for coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for Comedy Africa on one of Wikipedia's sister projects: Wiktionary, Wikibooks, Wikiquote, Wikisource, Wikiversity, Commons, Wikivoyage, Wikinews, Wikidata, Wikispecies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the topic appears on a sister project, that may inform whether a full Wikipedia article is appropriate or where to find related resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page visibility delay / use purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect the page exists but cannot see it, allow time for propagation or use the purge function to refresh the page display.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case sensitivity and consider adding a redirect
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization and create redirects when appropriate so readers can find the article under common variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: If deleted, check the deletion log and deletion guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a missing page may be due to deletion, consult the deletion log and guidance pages to understand reasons and possible remedies (e.g., recreate with adequate sourcing or request undeletion).
